name: io.github.tonyyang0504/shopify-mcp
description: Shopify (builder tools): me, list_items, get_item, create_item, update_item, delete_item. Every tool

environmentVariables.name: PLATFORM_MCP_SHOPIFY_ACCESS_TOKEN
environmentVariables.description: Admin API access token of a custom app installed on the store (Settings > Apps and sales channels > Develop apps), with read_products/write_products scopes; sent as X-Shopify-Access-Token.

environmentVariables.name: PLATFORM_MCP_SHOPIFY_SHOP
environmentVariables.description: The store's myshopify subdomain (the part before .myshopify.com).
